message.title: Kristin O. Augestad appointed interim CEO of Multiconsult
message.body:
Multiconsult (OSE: MULTI)
The board of directors of Multiconsult ASA has appointed Kristin O. Augestad as
interim Chief Executive Officer with immediate effect. Augestad will serve as
interim CEO while the company progresses the proposed merger with Rejlers.

Augestad currently serves as EVP Norway and will continue in that role while
also serving as interim CEO. She has held a number of leadership positions
within the group. She joined Multiconsult in 1997 and has been a member of
executive management team for several years.
"Kristin knows Multiconsult exceptionally well and has been instrumental in
developing both our business and organisation over many years. The board is
confident that she is the right person to lead the company through this
important phase," says Rikard Appelgren, Chair of the board of directors of
Multiconsult ASA.
"I look forward to leading Multiconsult through this exciting and important
period as we prepare for the planned merger with Rejlers and continue to support
our clients and employees across the group," says Kristin O. Augestad.
Karsten Warloe and the Board of Directors have mutually agreed that Karsten will
leave his role as CEO.
"The ongoing merger process has materially changed the context in which Karsten
Warloe was appointed CEO. Against this background, the Board and Karsten have
mutually agreed that a leadership transition is the appropriate way forward.
Karsten has made an important contribution during a demanding and significant
period for Multiconsult, and we would like to thank him for his commitment and
contribution and wish him all the best for the future," says Rikard Appelgren,
Chair of the Board.
